name: Sequential unit-track re-verification fleet
release: no release - this track's product is a verification verdict file (documentation), never code
operator_directive: Create new track to sequentially run all those tracks on a separate reasonix session, that is meant so you don't run out of context on this session
acceptance: AC-1: a separate Reasonix session (fresh context, not this session) is launched by the track's launcher and executes ALL 18 unit tracks sequentially, in the declared order

AC-2: every unit track's verification is re-run live on the current tree: its certificate files are executed with npx mocha and the result (pass/fail/count) is recorded per track in sequencer_verdict.md
AC-3: the full unit suite is re-run live (npx mocha --recursive test/unit --timeout 30000) once, after all per-track runs, and its final counts are recorded
AC-4: no file under js/**, no manifest.json, and no test file is modified by the sequencer run (git status -- js/ must remain empty; any modification aborts the run and is reported)
AC-5: the sequencer session writes exactly two artifacts: sequencer_verdict.md and progress.jsonl (both inside this track's directory) - nothing else is committed
AC-6: housekeeping guard (python vendor/housekeeping_guard.py check) reports no issue/track debt attributable to this track at close-out
AC-7: the run lands as a local commit only (Conventional Commits template, explicit paths, never git add -A) - no push, per house rule

#1.text: **AC-1** — a separate Reasonix session (fresh context, not the session that created this track) is launched by the launcher and executes ALL 18 unit tracks sequentially, in the order in `metadata.json`'s `execution.track_order`.

#2.text: **AC-2** — every unit track's certificate files are executed live with `npx mocha` and the result (pass/fail/count) is recorded per track in `sequencer_verdict.md`.

#3.text: **AC-3** — the full unit suite is re-run live once, after the per-track runs (`npx mocha --recursive test/unit --timeout 30000`), final counts recorded.

#4.text: **AC-4** — no file under `js/**`, no `manifest.json`, and no test file is modified by the sequencer run (`git status -- js/` must remain empty; any modification aborts the run and is reported in the verdict).

#5.text: **AC-5** — the sequencer session writes exactly two artifacts: `sequencer_verdict.md` and `progress.jsonl` (both inside this track's directory) — nothing else is committed.

#6.text: **AC-6** — `python vendor/housekeeping_guard.py check` reports no issue/track debt attributable to this track at close-out.

#7.text: **AC-7** — the run lands as a local commit only (Conventional Commits, explicit paths, never `git add -A`), no push.
